tips.tired_of_typing_keep_going: Tired of typing "keep going"? Just send a '.'
tips.quick_actions: Type `#` anywhere in your prompt for quick actions — copy the line or the whole prompt, undo, jump the cursor
tips.slash_commands: Type `/` at the start of your prompt to browse every command
tips.bang_bash: Start your prompt with `!` to run it as bash — `!!` runs it without adding the output to context
tips.dollar_python: Start your prompt with `$ ` to run Python — `$$ ` runs it without adding the output to context
tips.btw_side_question: You can /btw to ask a side question
tips.tan_background_agent: Use /tan to fork the current conversation into a background agent
tips.ctrl_d_exit: With default keybindings, {key:ctrl+d} deletes the character under the cursor instead of quitting your draft — see /hotkeys for your exit key
tips.ompt_stats: Find out which model you emotionally abuse the most with `omp stats`
tips.task_isolation: Try task isolation to create CoW worktrees
tips.completion_nested: Need a cheap nested model call? Use `completion(x...)`. Have a big batch of tasks? Ask clanker to use it!
tips.multi_session: Did you know? Each kitty/tmux/cmux/zellij/wezterm split keeps its own session — `omp -c` resumes the right one
tips.ultrathink: Drop the word `ultrathink` in your message for harder multi-step reasoning — watch it glow rainbow as you type
tips.chillax: Agent overthinking? Say `chillax` — on models with per-message effort, thinking drops to the lowest level, even mid-turn — watch it glow as you type
tips.orchestrate: Say `orchestrate` in your message to drive a multi-phase task with parallel subagents — watch it glow as you type
tips.workflowz: Say `workflowz` in your message to drive the task with parallel subagents in eval — watch it glow as you type
tips.jevify: Bulk data to classify or triage? Say `jevify` in your message — the eval kernel's `judge()` processes the batch and you read only what it flags — watch it glow as you type
tips.multi_account: Log in to several accounts of the same provider — `/login` again — and omp load-balances across them automatically
tips.auth_broker: Run `omp auth-broker serve` once and every machine pulls live tokens over the wire — refresh keys never leave the host; `omp auth-gateway` fronts it as a drop-in proxy any OpenAI-compatible client can hit
tips.switch_provider: Press {key:alt+p} (or /switch) to switch provider, and {key:ctrl+p} to cycle role models smol -> slow -> etc
tips.ctrl_r_history: Press {key:ctrl+r} to search your prompt history and reuse a past message
tips.force_read: `/force read` pins the next turn to one specific tool when the model keeps reaching for the wrong one
tips.copy_code: `/copy code` grabs the last code block to your clipboard — `/copy cmd` grabs the last shell/python command
tips.shake: `/shake` rips heavy tool results out of context to reclaim tokens without a full /compact — `/shake images` drops just images
tips.collab: Pair up live: `/collab` shares your session through an end-to-end encrypted relay link — a teammate runs `/join <link>` to watch tool calls stream and prompt the agent from their own omp
tips.inspect_transcript: Press {tap:left} to drill into a running or finished agent and inspect its tool calls and transcript
tips.usage_reset: Hit a Codex rate limit? `/usage reset` spends a saved reset credit to immediately restore your quota
tips.pi_dialect: No native tool_calling? Inference provider botches parsing them? `PI_DIALECT=glm|kimi|anthropic…` rolls it locally for them!
tips.advisor: Turn on `/advisor` to attach a second model that reviews every turn and quietly injects advice
tips.prompt_arrow_list: Try starting your prompt with a ->, and writing a list (1. Do X, 2. Do Y)
tips.shift_tab_effort: Press {key:shift+tab} to cycle through reasoning effort levels
tips.self_reconfigure: omp can reconfigure and extend itself — ask any questions you have!
tips.cleanse: Lint/type errors piling up? `omp cleanse` (or /cleanse right here) hunts project diagnostics and fixes them with parallel subagents — {key:escape} cancels
